theme.en: AI Infrastructure Tests Every Supply Constraint
theme.zh: AI基础设施考验全链条供给约束

dek.en: Hyperscaler spending and new GPU clusters keep compute demand high, while memory costs, advanced packaging, fab resilience, and supporting materials become the practical limits. The resulting investments are reaching beyond chips into foundry services, gases, and regional equipment supply chains.
dek.zh: 云厂商资本开支与新增GPU集群继续推高算力需求，而存储成本、先进封装、晶圆厂韧性及配套材料正成为实际约束。相关投资已从芯片本身延伸至代工服务、工业气体和区域化设备供应链。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Big Tech's AI Infrastructure Bill Passes $1 Trillion
title.zh: 科技巨头AI基础设施投入突破1万亿美元

summary.en: Amazon, Google, Meta, and Microsoft have collectively spent more than $1 trillion on AI investment since 2023, according to the report. The four are expected to add another $745 billion in 2026, making sustained demand for accelerators, networking, power, and data-center construction the central industry question rather than a one-quarter procurement surge.
summary.zh: 报道称，Amazon、Google、Meta和Microsoft自2023年以来在AI相关投入上合计已超过1万亿美元。四家公司预计将在2026年再增加7450亿美元，这意味着加速器、网络、电力和数据中心建设的持续需求，而非单季采购高潮，正成为产业的核心变量。

title.en: Moonshot Reportedly Gains Access to an Alibaba Nvidia Cluster
title.zh: Moonshot据报通过阿里云获得Nvidia集群

summary.en: Bloomberg reported that Moonshot has obtained access to an Nvidia chip cluster through an Alibaba computing deal. The arrangement would put a major Chinese model developer closer to scarce high-end training capacity, while also drawing attention to how cloud access intersects with U.S. export-control enforcement.
summary.zh: Bloomberg报道称，Moonshot通过一项阿里云计算交易获得了Nvidia芯片集群的使用权。这一安排将使这家中国大模型开发商更接近稀缺的高端训练算力，同时也令云端访问与美国出口管制执行之间的关系受到更多关注。

title.en: Apple Flags AI Compute Capacity as a Product Risk
title.zh: Apple将AI算力容量列为产品交付风险

summary.en: Apple's 10-Q warns that it could face shortages of AI and machine-learning computing capacity, alongside supply-chain constraints that may affect current-quarter revenue growth. The disclosure is notable because it frames compute availability as a potential limiter on products and services, not merely an operating-cost issue.
summary.zh: Apple在10-Q文件中警示，公司可能面临AI和机器学习计算容量短缺，且供应链约束可能影响当季营收增长。这一披露值得关注，因为它将算力可得性界定为可能限制产品和服务交付的因素，而不只是运营成本问题。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Japan Earthquake Disrupts Kyushu Semiconductor Operations
title.zh: 日本地震扰动九州半导体生产

summary.en: Chip manufacturers suspended operations in Kyushu after an earthquake disrupted local production, according to the report. Even short stoppages matter in a tightly supplied ecosystem because restarting cleanroom processes, qualifying output, and clearing work in progress can extend the operational impact beyond the initial event.
summary.zh: 报道称，日本地震扰动当地生产后，多家芯片制造商暂停了九州地区的运营。对于供应紧张的产业生态而言，即使短暂停工也不容忽视：洁净室制程重启、产出认证以及在制品清理，都可能使影响持续超过事件本身。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Apple Expects Another Step Up in Memory Costs
title.zh: Apple预计存储器成本还将进一步上升

summary.en: Tim Cook said Apple expects to pay more for memory in the September quarter than it did in June after recent price increases. The company has nearly doubled inventory to $11.09 billion, signaling that memory pricing is now large enough to pressure gross margin and procurement planning at major device makers.
summary.zh: Tim Cook表示，在近期涨价之后，Apple在9月季度支付的存储器成本将高于6月季度。公司库存已接近翻倍至110.9亿美元，表明存储器价格已足以影响大型终端厂商的毛利率和采购规划。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Linde Wins Arizona Gas-Supply Contract for a Semiconductor Complex
title.zh: Linde获得亚利桑那半导体园区工业气体供应合同

summary.en: Linde has been awarded a contract to supply industrial gases to a semiconductor-manufacturing complex in Arizona. Bulk gases are an essential fab utility rather than a peripheral service, so the award is another sign that U.S. capacity expansion is pulling investment through the materials and facility-infrastructure stack.
summary.zh: Linde获得了一份合同，将向亚利桑那一座半导体制造园区供应工业气体。大宗气体是晶圆厂的关键公用工程而非边缘服务，因此该合同进一步表明，美国扩产正在带动材料和厂务基础设施全链条投资。

title.en: CEA-Leti Puts 3D Stacking at the Center of AI Scaling
title.zh: CEA-Leti将3D堆叠置于AI扩展的核心

summary.en: CEA-Leti is advancing a roadmap built around 3D stacking, chiplets, and improved power and cooling as AI systems run into memory-bandwidth and energy limits. The framing matters because it treats advanced packaging as system architecture: performance gains increasingly depend on moving data and power efficiently, not only shrinking transistor dimensions.
summary.zh: 随着AI系统遭遇内存带宽和能耗限制，CEA-Leti正推进以3D堆叠、chiplet以及更优供电和散热为核心的路线图。这一思路的重要性在于，它将先进封装视为系统架构：性能提升越来越依赖于高效传输数据和供电，而不只是缩小晶体管尺寸。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: FTC Clears IonQ's Purchase of SkyWater Foundry
title.zh: FTC批准IonQ收购SkyWater晶圆厂

summary.en: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission approved IonQ's acquisition of SkyWater Technology, clearing a deal that links a quantum-computing company with a specialty semiconductor foundry. The transaction puts fabrication capability closer to IonQ's hardware roadmap and illustrates continued interest in vertically aligned, domestic supply for non-CMOS compute platforms.
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会批准IonQ收购SkyWater Technology，这笔交易将量子计算公司与一家特色半导体晶圆厂连接起来。该交易使制造能力更贴近IonQ的硬件路线图，也显示出市场持续关注面向非CMOS计算平台的垂直整合和本土供应。

title.en: Challengers & Deals
title.zh: 挑战者与交易

title.en: NXP Is Reportedly in Talks for a $3 Billion-Plus Automotive Camera-Chip Deal
title.zh: NXP据报洽谈逾30亿美元的汽车摄像头芯片交易

summary.en: NXP is in talks to acquire a designer of camera chips for self-driving cars for more than $3 billion, the Financial Times reported. If completed, the deal would add image-sensing capability to NXP's automotive portfolio at a time when the content of vision and edge-processing silicon per vehicle continues to rise.
summary.zh: 《金融时报》报道称，NXP正洽谈以逾30亿美元收购一家自动驾驶摄像头芯片设计商。若交易完成，NXP将在其汽车产品组合中补足图像感知能力；与此同时，单车所需的视觉和边缘处理芯片价值仍在上升。

theme.en: Making Efficient AI Compute More Physical
theme.zh: 让高效AI计算更贴近物理实现

dek.en: This week's work moves beyond model-level efficiency into sparse dataflows, quantization hardware, analog-memory drift, and the formal tools needed to build them. Several papers pair algorithms with measured or implementation-aware hardware costs, though most remain preprints and need independent validation.
dek.zh: 本周研究将效率优化从模型层面推进到稀疏数据流、量化硬件、模拟存储漂移以及相应的形式化工具。多篇论文把算法与实测或面向实现的硬件成本结合起来，但大多仍为预印本，尚需独立验证。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Nanoparticle Networks for Neuromorphic Computing
title.zh: 用于神经形态计算的纳米颗粒网络

papers.authors: J. Mensing, W. G. van der Wiel, A. Heuer

summary.en: The authors turn metallic nanoparticles linked by molecular junctions on SiO2/Si into a tunable nonlinear reservoir by surrounding them with control electrodes. Their analysis identifies operating frequency, oxide thickness, and junction disorder as design levers for balancing tunneling nonlinearity against memory. It offers useful physical rules for reservoir hardware, although the paper's computational benefits will depend on reproducibility across fabricated networks.
summary.zh: 作者在SiO2/Si衬底上利用分子结连接金属纳米颗粒，并通过周围控制电极将其转化为可调非线性储备池。研究指出工作频率、氧化层厚度和结的无序度是平衡隧穿非线性与记忆特性的关键设计变量。该工作为储备池硬件提供了有用的物理设计规则，但其计算收益仍取决于不同制造网络之间的可重复性。

title.en: Sparse Tensor Contractions Near the Vector-Processor Roofline
title.zh: 逼近向量处理器屋顶线的稀疏张量收缩

papers.authors: B. Wang, C. Zhang, D. Shen, et al.

summary.en: Ventaglio adds a configurable sparse-execution unit and RVV extensions for indexed gather-accumulate-scatter operations used in Transformer inference. In a 12 nm open-source vector cluster, the design reports 6.9–7.4× faster sparse contractions than optimized RVV baselines for a 3.1% cluster-area overhead. The results make a strong architectural case, but their system-level value depends on workloads retaining enough structured sparsity to amortize metadata handling.
summary.zh: Ventaglio为Transformer推理中的索引式gather-accumulate-scatter操作加入可配置稀疏执行单元和RVV扩展。在12 nm开源向量集群中，设计相对优化RVV基线实现了6.9–7.4倍的稀疏张量收缩加速，集群面积开销为3.1%。结果有力支持该架构思路，但系统层面的收益仍取决于工作负载能否保持足够的结构化稀疏性，以摊薄元数据处理成本。

title.en: Recovering Floating-Gate CIM Accuracy After Retention Loss
title.zh: 缓解浮栅存算一体的保持损失以恢复精度

papers.authors: M. Brazzini, G. Filippeschi, A. Catania, et al.

summary.en: This paper combines circuit-level compensation with batch-normalization recalibration to offset retention loss in a 65 nm single-poly floating-gate analog CIM array. With a retention model calibrated to experiments, the authors recover baseline inference accuracy to within 2–4% after 60 days on VGG-10 and WideResNet workloads. It directly addresses a practical deployment problem, though the result leaves endurance, reprogramming overhead, and broader model coverage to be quantified.
summary.zh: 论文将电路级补偿与batch normalization重校准结合，用于抵消65 nm单层多晶硅浮栅模拟存算一体阵列的保持损失。基于实验校准的保持模型，作者在VGG-10和WideResNet任务上将编程60天后的推理精度恢复到距基线2–4%以内。该研究直面实际部署难题，但耐久性、重编程开销和更广泛模型覆盖仍有待量化。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: GyRot: Rotation-Aware Group Quantization for Low-Bit LLMs
title.zh: GyRot：面向低比特大模型的旋转感知分组量化

papers.authors: S. Kim, Y. Choi, B. Kim, et al.

summary.en: GyRot co-designs coarse rotation, fine-grained grouping, and integer dequantization to avoid the mismatch between global rotations and local quantization scales. Its INT4 tensor-processing element reports up to 3.4× speedup and 3.6× energy efficiency over baseline LLM accelerators while maintaining leading 4-bit LLaMA-family accuracy. The claims are promising, but comparison against production quantization stacks and complete memory-system costs will determine portability.
summary.zh: GyRot协同设计粗粒度旋转、细粒度分组和整数反量化，以避免全局旋转与局部量化尺度之间的不匹配。其INT4张量处理单元在保持LLaMA系列领先4 bit精度的同时，相对基线LLM加速器报告最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升。结果颇具潜力，但与生产级量化栈及完整存储系统成本的比较将决定其可移植性。

title.en: Dynamic Operator Scheduling Beyond Prefill–Decode Disaggregation
title.zh: 超越Prefill–Decode解耦的动态算子调度

papers.authors: J. Yang, J. Li, Y. Fu, et al.

summary.en: DOPS schedules LLM operators across heterogeneous NPU and processing-in-memory systems while also choosing blockwise weight layouts under memory constraints. The Bifocal scheduler achieves a 1.20–2.23× geometric-mean speedup over a prefill–decode baseline, and layout selection adds a further 1.28–1.33×. The framework is useful because it treats contention and weight placement as first-class factors, although it needs validation on commercially deployed heterogeneous servers.
summary.zh: DOPS在异构NPU与processing-in-memory系统之间调度LLM算子，同时在内存约束下选择分块权重布局。Bifocal调度器相对prefill–decode基线取得1.20–2.23倍几何平均加速，布局选择再带来1.28–1.33倍提升。该框架将资源争用和权重摆放视为一等因素，但仍需在商用异构服务器上验证。

title.en: Devices & Reliability
title.zh: 器件与可靠性

title.en: Accurate Write-Error Modeling for Asymmetric MRAM
title.zh: 非轴对称MRAM的精确写入错误建模

papers.authors: F. Garcia Redondo, T. Bhowmik, M. G. Monteiro, et al.

summary.en: The work develops a two-dimensional finite-volume Fokker–Planck solver for write-error rates in STT- and SOT-MRAM devices whose symmetry is broken by fields or torques. It is validated against one million stochastic LLG trajectories and shows that discretization choice can materially change predicted error rates. This is a modeling advance rather than a new cell demonstration, but it could improve design margins for magnetic memories with complex switching dynamics.
summary.zh: 该研究为受磁场或力矩破坏对称性的STT和SOT-MRAM器件建立二维有限体积Fokker–Planck写入错误率求解器。模型与100万条随机LLG轨迹进行了验证，并显示离散化方案会实质性改变预测错误率。这是一项建模进展而非新存储单元演示，但有望改善复杂翻转动力学磁存储器的设计裕量。

title.en: Circuits & Architectures
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: A 16 nm Sparse Convolution Accelerator for Edge Vision
title.zh: 面向边缘视觉的16 nm稀疏卷积加速器

papers.authors: J. Zhuge, J. Partzsch, C. Mayr

summary.en: A 16 nm sparse-convolution accelerator uses bitmap compression and an idle-first task assignment policy to reduce bandwidth demand and processing-element imbalance. The reported core area is 0.5 mm² and power is 12–16 mW, with a dedicated dataflow for depthwise separable convolution. Its silicon-oriented constraints make it relevant to edge vision, though the practical advantage depends on sparsity patterns and end-to-end sensor-system energy.
summary.zh: 这款16 nm稀疏卷积加速器采用位图压缩和idle-first任务分配策略，以降低带宽需求及处理单元负载不均。其报告的核心面积为0.5 mm²、功耗为12–16 mW，并为depthwise separable convolution设计专用数据流。其面向硅实现的约束使之与边缘视觉相关，但实际优势仍取决于稀疏模式和端到端传感系统能耗。

title.en: EDA & Verification
title.zh: EDA与验证

title.en: CircuitProver: Reusable Lean 4 Proofs for Hardware Verification
title.zh: CircuitProver：用于硬件验证的可复用Lean 4证明

papers.authors: Z. Yang, W. Fang, C. Chen, et al.

summary.en: CircuitProver translates parameterized hardware and natural-language specifications into Lean 4 models, then uses an agentic loop to construct machine-checked proofs. Its key proposal is to retain proof traces and theorems as reusable libraries instead of re-solving each design instance with opaque model checking. The idea could lower repeated formal-verification effort, but its value will depend on translation fidelity and performance on industrial-scale RTL.
summary.zh: CircuitProver将参数化硬件和自然语言规格转换为Lean 4模型，再通过代理式循环构造机器检查证明。其核心主张是把证明轨迹和定理沉淀为可复用库，而不是以不透明模型检查为每个设计实例重新求解。这一思路可能降低重复形式验证工作量，但其价值将取决于转换保真度及其在工业级RTL上的性能。

title.en: VPR-Evolve Uses Agents to Specialize FPGA Place and Route
title.zh: VPR-Evolve使用智能体特化FPGA布局布线

papers.authors: Q. Wu, T. Jafri, A. Arora, V. A. Chhabria

summary.en: VPR-Evolve uses LLM agents to modify the source code of the VPR FPGA place-and-route flow for each target design, scoring candidates through full builds and runs. Across five VTR-9 benchmarks, it improves a composite delay, wirelength, and runtime score by up to 2.7% over stock VPR. The measured gain is modest, yet the work tests a more consequential premise: agents can search beyond conventional CAD hyperparameters if evaluation remains rigorous.
summary.zh: VPR-Evolve使用LLM智能体为每个目标设计修改VPR FPGA布局布线流程的源代码，并通过完整编译和运行来评估候选方案。在五个VTR-9基准上，其延迟、线长和运行时间的综合评分相对原版VPR最高提升2.7%。测得增益并不大，但该工作检验了一个更重要的前提：只要评估足够严格，智能体可以探索超越传统CAD超参数调优的空间。
